headline: Sensex and Nifty rally led by FII inflows, lower crude oil, and FMCG gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows drove positive sentiment across benchmark indices.
Lower crude oil prices helped boost early trade momentum.
FMCG stocks gained significantly, with ITC rallying 4%.
Wholesale inflation surged to 12.29% in October driven by higher fuel and power prices.
whatHappening: Sensex gained over 700 points while Nifty crossed the 25,300 level during intraday trading.
ITC led FMCG gains, rallying 4% and continuing its positive November trajectory.
Glenmark launched generic Inlyta tablets for kidney cancer treatment in the US market.
October wholesale inflation hit 12.29% due to surging power and energy costs.
summary: Indian equity markets traded sharply higher on Monday with Nifty crossing 25,300 and Sensex up significantly. The surge was propelled by sustained FII inflows, reduced crude oil prices, and strong buying in FMCG heavyweights like ITC. However, macroeconomic concerns surfaced as October wholesale inflation surged to 12.29%.
